desc: The Hotel Continental at Avenida Roque Sáenz Peña 725, Buenos Aires, Argentina, at the time of its inauguration, from a 1930s postcard. Built in 1927 by Alejandro Bustillo, it is now known as the 725 Continental Hotel: see [1].
